payload.reason: The evidence provides specific baseline methods used for comparison in the study, detailing their characteristics and approaches.

claims.text: The baseline methods include: (1) Naive: a bag-of-words SVM classifier; (2) mSDA: a state-of-the-art method with discrete features; (3) NaiveNN: a non-domain-adaptive CNN; (4) AuxNN: a neural model using auxiliary tasks; (5) ADAN: an adversarial training method.
NaiveNN and other baseline methods train solely on the source domain, limiting their ability to produce discriminative features on the target domain.
MMD is another baseline method that minimizes domain discrepancy, commonly used in image processing but adapted for NLP in this context.
